description: 99 m² five-room apartment in Bobigny, ideal for families or groups. Four comfortable bedrooms, one minute from the T1 tram and metro line 7 (Paris in 10-15 minutes). Supermarkets and all amenities within walking distance. Spacious, bright and perfectly located! You also have two bathrooms, one with a bathtub and one with a large walk-in shower. There is also 1 parking space in a secure underground car park with 2 gates and a camera. The crockery available is shown in the photos, please check.The spaceComfortable 4-bedroom apartment with a spacious living area, two bathrooms, and a fully equipped kitchen — perfect for short or extended stays.Guest accessAll rooms are accessible except the laundry room, which is marked with a “Do Not Enter” sign.Other things to noteLinen and towels provided Non-smoking apartment No parties or events Self check-in available
